featured_reviews.name: Mamta Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
Circle Wealth Advisors Pvt Ltd develop an overall strategy for our client to meet their needs and goals through an array of Wealth Management service, that includes 3 steps which are Planning, Execution and Monitoring.
At Planning stage, we establish details about your assets and liability, income and expenditure, your relationship with the money, goals and aspirations for the short as well as long term, and also your commitment to meet your objective. After getting the understanding of the data gathered, we create a goal based plan, in which we align your all current investment with your goals and assess if there are any gaps in the current situation. Later, we present our recommendations in the written format which is our action plan.
At Execution stage, we implement the mutually agreed action plan. We will execute the plan only after your consent and not before that.
At Monitoring stage, which is also the most crucial part of the process of wealth management because it is the long term plan and it requires regular quarter as well as annual reviews. Any changes in circumstances, goals, preferences can be inculcated in the plan will during the review. We keep checking returns generated, corpus required for our goal is same, whether the planned goals are relevant or not and any new goals or aspiration being added.

𝗔𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗰𝗮𝗽𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟬,𝟬𝟬𝟬 𝗰𝗿𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗯𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗲𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀?

A widow walks into a bank to renew a fixed deposit meant for her child’s education. A year later, she discovers she has been sold a life insurance policy — and must pay another large premium or risk losing what she already put in.

This is not just mis-selling. It is a window into a larger problem: high upfront commissions, tax-free maturity proceeds, and a structure where the tax benefit meant for savers have been captured by insurers and the banks acting as their agents.

The real question is uncomfortable: are taxpayers subsidising savers — or Insurance sellers?

My latest Truth Be Told column in Business Standard asks: Who really benefits from tax-free insurance? And if the tax break must continue, should India create a transparent mutual-fund alternative with similar tax concessions, so the benefit finally reaches the saver?

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been the client of Finwisor from last two years and they are undoubtedly the best. My finances were never organised before but the assistance and advice from Finwisor professionals has helped me a lot.
The best is unlike other financial firms they do not forget their clients after the investment is done as their after service is pretty quick and customer friendly.
One can have look at their finances in real time with the help of their app.
I would definitely recommend Finwisor to someone who is looking to manage their money in a right direction.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: The team at Finwisor does an excellent job in helping you with your financial planning and ensures they are always available for any queries you might have, however big or small. They start with helping us set our goals first and then planning for them in the right way using the financial instruments available. The best thing is they help you with a tailor fit strategy to help achieve your goals. There is no compulsion to chose any particular instrument, they help you with the pros and cons of it and let you take the final call. Jay has been phenomenal in helping me with all these and crafting the right strategy for me. The way he explains things in such a simple manner is really commendable.

featured_reviews.name: Milind D
featured_reviews.review_text: I am writing this review after using the Finwisor services for more than a year. Jay has suggested the products based on my investment needs and which are appropriate for me. Jay and Divya always provided the needed support. It has been a nice experience with Finwisor and expects to continue the same. Thanks and all the best to Jay & his team.

featured_reviews.name: Shaumik Daityari
featured_reviews.review_text: While I am been battling to bring financial discipline ever since I started working almost three years ago, I first contacted Finwisor a few months ago. What followed were intense discussions on my professional, personal goals, and aspirations too. The team at Finwisor suggested improvements in allocating my investments, and also identified substantial savings in my taxes. Their services are highly recommended!
